hkp_drawings.title_original: Doorsnede HKP 600…1400-ligger (tekeningen HKP-600 … HKP-1400, april 09, schaal 1:20)

hkp.source_status: producer catalogue (folder, NEN EN 1991-2 era; profile drawings april 2009)

folder_sketch_mm.side_band: top 300 mm of each side with a 10 mm step (sketch chains 10/1430/10, 90/300/10)

published._columns: H mm: [A 1e5 mm2, v mm (centroid from soffit), I 1e9 mm4, Qeg kN/m]

geometry_notes: Implemented from the folder table/sketch edition because it reproduces the published A, v, I within 0.1 % for all ten sizes.

EDITION CONFLICT: the april 2009 1:20 profile drawings show top slab 250 and bottom slab 160 (same 1200 void, 140 webs, 100 chamfers) and HKP-600 as a SOLID section; with those drawings A would be 3.6e4 mm2 higher (HKP-1000: 7.92e5 vs 7.56e5) and HKP-600 2.4e5 higher. Not implemented; recorded only.

Convention: the 10 mm side step is modelled as a 10 mm recess of the top 300 mm of each side face with a 10 mm 45-degree transition (area 6100 mm2); this is what closes the constant 6000 mm2 difference between the plain box and the table for every size.
Bottom edge chamfers 15 x 15 taken from the 2009 drawings; the drawn ~20 mm top-edge chamfer is omitted (the step already defines the top corner).
Void: straight 100 x 100 chamfers; for H = 600/650 the void is only 215/265 mm high (100 + 15/65 + 100).

Vertices are the CAD vector coordinates of the 1:10 drawings (PDF units x 25.4/72 x 10), rounded to 0.5 mm; they reproduce every printed vertical dimension (125/320/130, 125/420/130) and the 400/1150/1156 widths exactly.
The printed horizontal chains are internally inconsistent (15 + 1150 + 15 = 1180 but the step width is 1172; 13 + 1160 + 13 = 1186); the vector geometry is used.

The HBM folder table (heading 'HUP', element h.o.h. 1200) lists Ab 3.62 / 2.75 / 3.93 e5 mm2 for 350/450/550, which cannot be the solid drawn sections (HBM-450 model 4.8e5 mm2) and is non-monotonic; recorded, not used for validation (pinned in tests).

folder_table._columns: B mm, Ab 1e5 mm2, v mm, I 1e9 mm4, Qeg kN/m

geometry_notes: Asymmetric edge (rand) beam used with HGKO-350; outline = CAD vector coordinates of the 1:10 drawing rounded to 0.5 mm. Printed: 500 / 265 / 400 / 365, widths 403 / 122 / 250 and 10 / 500 / 35 / 100 / 100 / 40, vellingkant 20x20 and 15x15.
The small V drip groove (~10 mm) under the ledge is included as drawn.
Origin convention for this asymmetric section: x = 0 at the middle of the 485 mm flat soffit; the inner (left) face is at x = -242.5.

hgko_note: HGKO-350…600 folder properties (B, Ab, v, I) are digit-for-digit identical to the already-implemented HKO350…600 (bridgebeams.nl.hko); the HGKO-350 drawing shows the same 990 / 360-270-360 outline. HGKO is therefore not re-implemented (no new profile).
